The current dsa_upstream_port() helper still assumes a unique CPU port
in the whole switch fabric. This is becoming wrong
fabric has its dedicated CPU port
column2: thus every port has an upstream port.

column1: Add a port argument to the dsa_upstream_port() helper and fetch its CPU
port instead of the deprecated unique fabric CPU port. A CPU or unused
port has no dedicated CPU port
column2: so return itself in this case.
change the return value from u8 to unsigned int since

column1: there is no need to limit the size here.
